combos_validity_order.name: combos_validity_order
combos_validity_order.value: "combos"."valid_until" is null or "combos"."valid_from" is null or "combos"."valid_until" >= "combos"."valid_from"

contract_versions_content_or_object.name: contract_versions_content_or_object
contract_versions_content_or_object.value: "contract_versions"."content" is not null or "contract_versions"."source_object_key" is not null

contracts_target_valid.name: contracts_target_valid
contracts_target_valid.value: ("contracts"."kind" = 'standard' and "contracts"."procedure_id" is null and "contracts"."combo_id" is null) or ("contracts"."kind" = 'procedure' and "contracts"."procedure_id" is not null and "contracts"."combo_id" is null) or ("contracts"."kind" = 'combo' and "contracts"."combo_id" is not null and "contracts"."procedure_id" is null)

followup_contracts_content_protected.name: followup_contracts_content_protected
followup_contracts_content_protected.value: ("followup_contracts"."content_ciphertext" is null and "followup_contracts"."content_nonce" is null and "followup_contracts"."content_key_version" is null) or ("followup_contracts"."content_ciphertext" is not null and "followup_contracts"."content_nonce" is not null and "followup_contracts"."content_key_version" is not null)

followups_offer_target_valid.name: followups_offer_target_valid
followups_offer_target_valid.value: ("followups"."offer_type" = 'procedure' and "followups"."combo_id" is null and "followups"."plan_id" is null and "followups"."plan_version_id" is null) or ("followups"."offer_type" = 'combo' and "followups"."combo_id" = "followups"."offer_id" and "followups"."plan_id" is null and "followups"."plan_version_id" is null) or ("followups"."offer_type" = 'plan' and "followups"."plan_id" = "followups"."offer_id" and "followups"."combo_id" is null and "followups"."plan_version_id" is not null)

followups_cancelled_state_valid.name: followups_cancelled_state_valid
followups_cancelled_state_valid.value: ("followups"."status" = 'cancelled' and "followups"."cancelled_at" is not null and "followups"."completed_at" is null and "followups"."cancellation_reason" is not null and length(trim("followups"."cancellation_reason")) > 0) or ("followups"."status" <> 'cancelled' and "followups"."cancelled_at" is null and "followups"."cancellation_reason" is null)

followups_completed_state_valid.name: followups_completed_state_valid
followups_completed_state_valid.value: ("followups"."status" = 'completed' and "followups"."completed_at" is not null and "followups"."cancelled_at" is null and "followups"."cancellation_reason" is null) or ("followups"."status" <> 'completed' and "followups"."completed_at" is null)

signature_participants_state_valid.name: signature_participants_state_valid
signature_participants_state_valid.value: ("signature_participants"."status" = 'signed' and "signature_participants"."signed_at" is not null) or ("signature_participants"."status" <> 'signed' and "signature_participants"."signed_at" is null)
